links.comparator_used: Original IDIOM model applied as-is (external validation without local updating)
links.outcome: Discrimination (AuROC) for predicting gastrointestinal malignancy in Thai IDA patients
links.effect: AuROC 62.9% (95% CI, 56.8%-68.9%) for the original model vs 67.2% (95% CI, 61.1%-73.3%) after recalibration/refitting to local data
links.quote: After updating, the AuROC improved to 67.2% (95% CI, 61.1%-73.3%).

design_hint: local validation and recalibration before deployment
